# Ahmed Alvee

> Solutions architect who built LLM pipelines with guardrails, AI agents and AWS data pipelines, and took them live with customers on site. MBA candidate at Rotterdam School of Management (2026 to 2027). AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Associate. Open to forward-deployed, solutions and AI consulting roles.

This page has an AI agent ("Ask my agent") that answers questions about Ahmed's work from his CV and notes.

## Results

- Data clean-up per submission: improved from about 1 hour to 6 to 10 minutes, with an AI pipeline (LangGraph, Claude via Amazon Bedrock) for 30+ clinics, including human review.
- Onboarding a new lab and clinic combination: improved from 3-5 days to under 1 day, with a configurable AWS pipeline.

## Experience

- Solutions Architect, Mesh Bio, Singapore (05/2022 to 12/2025). Built an AI clean-up pipeline for 30+ clinics, with human review, and its guardrails (system prompting, a LangGraph supervisor, Pydantic validation). Chose a vision language model for a medical identification pilot and evaluated frontier and open-weight models. Built prototypes, proofs of concept and MVPs and ran pilots in Indonesia. Built the lab and radiology data pipeline on AWS (Lambda, SNS, SQS, Step Functions, HL7), which improved the time to onboard a new lab and clinic combination from 3-5 days to under 1 day. Owned the integration APIs and led on-site deployment for the first overseas customer. Hired, coached, trained and supervised a team of 3 solutions engineers.
- AI Strategy Consultant, RSM Living Management Project, client Truvalu, Rotterdam (06/2026 to 07/2026). Defined the problem with the client (AI discovery), then designed a 5-stage AI monitoring workflow with a 5-person MBA team, projected to improve monitoring time for an impact investor by about 45%. Built AI tools and agents as proofs of concept and an MVP.
- Software Engineer, Creative Medtech Solutions, Singapore (09/2021 to 04/2022). Imaging annotation and interaction layer for a HIFU cancer-ablation robot, including DICOM export.
- Research Assistant, Singapore University of Technology and Design (02/2018 to 08/2021). Locomotion code for a 12+ robot mapping system. ML pipeline recognizing 7 hand gestures.

## Projects

- LazySplit, own product (02/2026 to now), https://lazysplit.online/. A bill-splitting web app Ahmed designed, built and runs, live with real users and paid plans: scan a receipt, share one link, and everyone claims what they had. Receipt scanning is a vision LLM pipeline (Gemini 3.8 Flash through OpenRouter, Qwen3-VL fallback) with a strict JSON schema and an arithmetic check for tax and service lines; every item stays editable before sharing. Friends join without an account and claim live. Business rules live in the database (row-level security, triggers, server-side quotas and rate limits) with adversarial SQL tests. Rebuilt from a written spec in 14 phases with Claude Code. Stack: Next.js, React, Supabase, Stripe, Vercel.
